name: spine stretch forward
description: A seated pilates stretch where you round forward over your legs, one vertebra at a time. It mobilizes the spine and stretches the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Flex your feet and lift your torso up out of your hips.
Curl your chin to your chest and round forward, reaching past your toes.
Hold for a breath, then stack your spine back up slowly.
